notes: CSRF is non-applicable to the workspace command API (backend bearer tokens, no cookie sessions); replay protection is provided by X-Idempotency-Key dedup + optimistic revision checks (SE11/SE12).

entries.threat: secrets leak into logs, events, errors, screenshots or evidence
profile readable at rest by an unauthorized process
entries.control: AES-GCM encryption at rest + isolated profile copies + retention cleanup

entries.threat: navigation outside the approved domain or malicious redirect
entries.control: domain allowlist + redirect revalidation + credentials-in-URL denial

entries.threat: asset path escapes the workspace via ../ or symlink
entries.control: canonical path sandbox with resolve()-based boundary check
SSRF-safe URL/IP validation incl. DNS rebinding and redirect revalidation

entries.threat: executable/polyglot/oversized asset or malicious metadata accepted
entries.control: ordered media validation pipeline + pixel-bomb guard + EXIF sanitization

entries.threat: web/metadata text is treated as an instruction and reaches shell/filter
entries.control: typed envelopes + typed FFmpeg plan + shell policy (injection stays data)

entries.threat: arbitrary eval, cookie export, filesystem read or destructive shell executes
entries.control: bounded browser action policy + forbidden shell patterns + typed FFmpeg argv

entries.threat: a file outside the approved artifact store is uploaded
entries.control: approved asset store enforcement in upload policy

entries.threat: automation confirms terms/payment/delete/publish without a human
entries.control: confirmation-gated browser policy + permission-engine approval gating

media token format gate + idempotency + optimistic concurrency + project-scoped events; CSRF non-applicable (backend bearer API, no cookie session) with replay protection via idempotency keys and optimistic revision checks (SE11/SE12)

entries.threat: a stale approval (old revision/hash/catalog) unlocks a gate

entries.asset: rejected candidates / browser state / project references
entries.threat: data outlives retention or a deletion receipt leaks deleted content
entries.control: retention cleanup + non-destructive invalidation + content-free deletion receipts
